tags.inscription:en: "O the flats of death/ Invitingly prepared/ For the landlord of the house, who was otherwise a guest/ O you fingers/the threshold of entry/ like a knife between life and death/ O you chimneys/ O you fingers/And Israel's body/ in the smoke through the air!
